## Checklist

- [ ] Focused change, conventional commit prefix in the title
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run build` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `cargo fmt` run
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if users will notice
- [ ] Real smoke test run if sessions, approvals or the hook changed (or noted why not)
- [ ] No secrets or personal paths in the diff
